briefing: Markets were flat-to-slightly-down today (NASDAQ -0.3%, S&P 500 -0.4%), a neutral day overall. Rather than force capital into the market broadly, we added one high-conviction, fully-confirmed candidate (ALAB) to fill an open slot while holding all seven existing positions unchanged.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: When the overall market is neutral, it can still make sense to buy an individual stock if multiple independent technical signals — like RSI in a healthy bullish range, a MACD crossover, price above its moving average, and a volume surge — all line up together. Relying on several confirming signals rather than just one reduces the chance of chasing a false signal.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 當大盤走勢中性時,若個股同時出現多項獨立的技術訊號一致確認——例如RSI處於健康的多頭區間、MACD黃金交叉、股價站上均線、以及成交量放大——仍然值得考慮買入。依賴多項訊號共同確認,而非單一訊號,可以降低追高假訊號的風險。

market_education.summary_en: Major indices drifted modestly lower today with the NASDAQ down 0.3% and the S&P 500 down 0.4%, reflecting a broadly neutral, low-conviction session rather than any sharp risk-off move. No major market-moving headlines were flagged for today, consistent with the mild, directionless price action. Individual stocks with strong technical setups, like ALAB, still showed bullish momentum even as the overall market treaded water.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤走勢溫和偏軟,納斯達克指數下跌0.3%,標普500指數下跌0.4%,屬於中性、方向不明的交易日,並未出現明顯的避險賣壓。今日未有重大市場消息可供引述,與這種溫和且缺乏方向性的價格走勢相符。儘管大盤原地踏步,部分技術面強勢的個股(如ALAB)仍展現出上升動能。

trades.reasoning: All four bullish signals align (RSI in 55-70 zone, MACD crossover, price above SMA-20, volume surge) despite a neutral broad market, fitting the multi-signal confirmation lesson for filling an open slot.
